notes: Tasks use a fixed 'time', or an 'anchor' (wake or lightsOut) plus 'offset' minutes, so they move with the sleep shift. days: 0=Sun ... 6=Sat; no days = every day.

tasks.name: Out of bed
tasks.push: Feet on the floor. Don't negotiate with the bed. Open Daybreak and press Done. It'll walk you through the morning one step at a time.

tasks.name: Wash face + skincare
tasks.push: Brush teeth, wash face, cold water. Two minutes.

tasks.name: Make the bed
tasks.push: Make the bed. Once it's made, you can't crawl back in.

tasks.name: Morning stretch
tasks.push: 10-minute morning stretch. Today's flow is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Morning walk
tasks.push: Shoes and coat on. 15 minutes outside. Daylight in your eyes resets your body clock, so waking early gets easier.

tasks.name: Morning shower (body) + get dressed
tasks.push: Shower, body only (hair is tonight), then get dressed for the day.

tasks.name: Make + eat breakfast
tasks.push: Breakfast. Daybreak has a recipe ready for you. Aligners out, then brush and put them back in within 30 minutes.

tasks.name: Vitamin D + C
tasks.push: Vitamin D and C now, while breakfast is still in you. Vitamin D absorbs best with food.

tasks.name: Set today's one thing
tasks.push: What's the one thing that makes today a win? Write it down.

tasks.name: School work
tasks.push: School block. Phone in another room, start with the smallest task.

tasks.name: Make + eat lunch
tasks.push: Lunch time. Eat something real, not just a snack. Aligners out, then brush and put them back in within 30 minutes.

tasks.name: TESOL course
tasks.push: TESOL time. Even 25 minutes counts. Start now.

tasks.name: Afternoon walk
tasks.push: Walk before the sun goes down. Shoes on, out the door, 20 minutes.

tasks.name: Cook + eat dinner
tasks.push: Cook tonight. Tonight's recipe is in Daybreak. Aligners out, then brush and put them back in within 30 minutes.

tasks.name: Read
tasks.push: Reading hour. Phone in another room, book open.

tasks.name: Write
tasks.push: Writing hour. Phone away. Start with one ugly sentence.

tasks.name: Get ready + go to the gym
tasks.push: Gym in 30 minutes. Pack water, shoes, headphones and head out.

tasks.name: Gym, then home
tasks.push: Gym. Pack the bag and go. Tonight's plan is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Bedtime stretch + light exercise
tasks.push: No gym tonight. 20 minutes of stretching and light exercise before bed. Tonight's routine is in Daybreak.

tasks.name: Room reset
tasks.push: Room reset, about 30 minutes. Clothes away, surfaces clear, bin out, quick floor.

tasks.name: Wash face + skincare
tasks.push: Brush teeth, wash face. Winding down.

tasks.name: Check-in + tomorrow's one thing
tasks.push: Evening check-in, then pick tomorrow's one thing.

tasks.name: Night shower (body + hair)
tasks.push: Shower time: body and hair. When you're out, open Daybreak. It'll walk you through the rest of the night.

tasks.name: Switch to tray {next}
tasks.push: Tray change tonight. Switch to tray {next} of {total} after brushing. Pop tray {tray} in its case.

tasks.name: Phone away, lights out
tasks.push: Phone across the room, alarm across the room too. Lights out.

aligners.note: Tray 1 went in Fri Sep 4 (one extra day). Every change is Friday night before bed, so each tray counts from Saturday.
